question: Which country held a presidential runoff election on 13 April 2025, resulting in the re election of President Daniel Noboa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ecuador**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• On 13 April 2025, Ecuador held a presidential runoff election, resulting in the re-election of President **Daniel Noboa**.
 
• Daniel Noboa is one of the youngest presidents in Ecuador's history, having assumed office for his first term in 2023 at the age of 35.
 
• The runoff election was necessitated as no candidate secured the majority required in the first round of voting.
 
• Noboa's re-election campaign focused on economic reforms, crime reduction, and improving infrastructure in Ecuador.
 
• The election process was overseen by the National Electoral Council (CNE) of Ecuador to ensure transparency and fairness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Presidential Runoff Elections:**

 
 
• A runoff election is held when no candidate secures the majority threshold (usually 50%+1) in the first round of voting.
 
• This system ensures that the elected president has broad support from the electorate.
 
 
 
• **Daniel Noboa:**
 
 
• Daniel Noboa is the son of Álvaro Noboa, a prominent Ecuadorian businessman and five-time presidential candidate.
 
• He is known for his business acumen and has worked extensively in the banana export industry, which is a key sector in Ecuador's economy.
 
 
 
• **Ecuador's Political System:**
 
 
• Ecuador is a democratic republic with a presidential system of government.
 
• The president serves as both the head of state and government and is elected for a four-year term.
 
 
 
• **Key Challenges in Ecuador:**
 
 
• Ecuador faces significant challenges, including economic instability, high crime rates, and migration issues.
 
• Addressing these issues formed the cornerstone of Noboa's campaign platform.
